entries.title: Your panel instructions are kept with your other directions
entries.body: When you ask for something every panel should do, such as compact rows, your first mate keeps it as a direction for your personal workspace. You can see, change or retire it in Knowledge, under Directions. The instructions you gave before carry across on the first start after the update.
entries.noPicture: The Directions list looks the same; your panel instructions now appear in it beside your other directions.
